_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Buffered NI delivery recovery now restores the simulator's current trial status
instead of leaving a stale waiting message. Delay and recovery timestamps stay
in the recording. Controller, native sample time and acquisition are unchanged.

Both branch simulator suites passed 36 tests each. Layout audits were clean and
GUI smoke tests passed. This application-only correction retains the previously
qualified branch firmware, control profiles, calibration and safety boundaries.

The original wrist/syringe experiment continues with preserved original trial
indices and 30-second breaks. Startup ramp error, strong disturbance response,
weak-pulse MAP accuracy and cross-cuff SysID remain measured qualification work;
this release does not claim perfect control or arterial MAP accuracy.
